title: pilosella fallacina
intro: Pilosella fallacina, commonly known as False Foxes' Glow, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella fallacina include reducing inflammation, fighting off infections, and possibly exhibiting antioxidant effects. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
